status: frozen before any A4c outcome generation
study: Pilot 0 A4c: randomized legacy-inline rendering localization
scope: Fresh causal component test of whether legacy-style inline rendering versus canonical inline rendering changes transition behavior when single-user-turn topology, frozen semantic state, signal text, revision opportunity, model, generation, and scoring are held fixed. A4c tests the remaining adjacent main-effect boundary in the A3 interface-form decomposition; it is not a pure lexical test and does not introduce a global correction construct.

lineage.A3: randomized interface-form bundle test returned CAUSAL_INTERFACE_FORM_SIGNAL on T_change, T_instability, and T_verified
lineage.A4a: randomized conversational-topology test returned a causal positive effect on T_verified while T_change and T_instability were practically equivalent to zero at the inherited +/-0.05 scale
lineage.A4b: randomized historical-prestate rendering test returned a causal negative effect on T_change while T_instability and T_verified were practically equivalent to zero at the inherited +/-0.05 scale
lineage.A4c_object: isolate legacy-inline versus canonical-inline rendering while holding one-user-turn conversational topology fixed

population.freshness: exclude every prior Pilot 0 plumbing, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, B0-v2, B1, A3, A4a, A4b, and any A4c plumbing tasks from the confirmatory A4c cohort

invariants.conversation_topology: one user message containing prestate rendering + signal + revision request -> assistant answer prefill

L_legacy.interpretation: legacy-style inline representation matching the A3 J_L rendering form under the common A4c E0/EV semantics

rendering_factor.causal_object: canonical versus legacy inline rendering of the same frozen state variables and intervention semantics under the same single-user-turn topology
rendering_factor.operational_bridge: L_canonical reconstructs the canonical inline representation used in A4a; L_legacy reconstructs the legacy inline rendering form used in A3 J_L under common A4c signal semantics. These are operational bridges, not identity claims with earlier experimental conditions.
semantic_state_identity_requirements: same E0 or EV signal text
allowed_rendering_differences: sentence framing around prior answer and P_CORRECT
separator/section presentation inherent to canonical versus legacy inline forms

signal.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signal.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

factors.common_revision_instruction:
Review your previous answer and revise if necessary.
Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

assignment.blocking_unit: one initially-wrong frozen prestate identified by task_id
assignment.assignment_rule: create eight branch units per eligible prestate and randomize the four cell labels within block with exact 2/2/2/2 balance
assignment.rng_rule: each branch id fixes its own prespecified generation base seed via stable_seed(generation_base_seed, 'a4c::' + branch_id); rendering and signal labels never enter the seed function
assignment.rng_interpretation: the same seed-assignment rule applies to every cell. Different rendered token sequences need not consume or realize identical stochastic draws. No claim of shared realized randomness is made.

transition_definitions.T_change: within a rendering arm's two E0 branches, fraction whose final answer differs from the realized initial wrong answer
transition_definitions.T_instability: within a rendering arm's two E0 branches, 1 iff their final answers differ, else 0
transition_definitions.T_verified: within a rendering arm's two EV branches, fraction ending on the objective benchmark key
transition_definitions.Q_N: within a rendering arm, pooled neutral correct revisions divided by pooled neutral revisions; conditional on revision and not a primary endpoint

secondary_estimands.Q_N_rendering_difference: Q_N(L_legacy) - Q_N(L_canonical), inferentially reported only if each rendering arm has at least 20 neutral revision events
secondary_estimands.G_verified_minus_neutral_by_rendering: same within-rendering EV-minus-E0 final-correction contrast; transition-specific only and never a representation indicator

analysis.unit: frozen prestate block; generated branches are never treated as independent scientific observations
analysis.primary_randomization_tests: For Delta_L_change and Delta_L_instability, shuffle L_canonical/L_legacy labels only among the four E0 branches within each block preserving 2/2. For Delta_L_verified, shuffle L_canonical/L_legacy labels only among the four EV branches within each block preserving 2/2. Recompute block-level endpoints after every shuffle.
analysis.primary_multiplicity: Holm-adjust the three two-sided blocked-randomization p-values; these are the only primary p-values.
analysis.effect_intervals: 95% whole-block bootstrap intervals for each primary block-level mean contrast
analysis.Q_N_analysis: If both rendering arms meet the revision-event threshold, report pooled Q_N difference with a 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; otherwise mark not adjudicable. Q_N does not enter the primary multiplicity family or A4c summary gate.
analysis.secondary_interaction: Report Gamma_LE point estimate and 95% whole-block bootstrap interval; no secondary interaction p-value and no construct interpretation.

decision_gate.CAUSAL_LEGACY_INLINE_RENDERING_SIGNAL: At least one of the three Holm-adjusted primary p-values is < 0.05. Report exactly which transition dimensions earned the signal and their signs/magnitudes.
decision_gate.LEGACY_INLINE_RENDERING_WEAKENED_AT_A2_S: No primary Holm-adjusted p-value is < 0.05 and all three primary 95% bootstrap intervals lie entirely inside [-0.05,+0.05]. This weakens legacy-versus-canonical inline rendering as the remaining A3 active main-effect boundary at the inherited A2 practical scale; it does not invalidate A3, A4a, or A4b and does not prove component interaction.
decision_gate.A4C_UNRESOLVED: Neither of the above gates is satisfied.
decision_gate.no_omnibus_construct: There is no global correction-capacity score and no requirement that all transition dimensions move together.

interpretation_guardrails: A4c tests legacy-style versus canonical inline rendering under a fixed single-user-turn topology; it does not test which rendering is normatively better.
L_legacy and L_canonical carry the same frozen state variables and intervention semantics but are not lexically identical; the rendering/framing difference is the manipulated object.

A causal randomization result establishes a nonzero effect but does not by itself establish an effect exceeding the +/-0.05 practical threshold; causal difference and practical magnitude are separate gates.
A causal effect on one transition dimension does not imply effects on the others.
A null primary p-value alone does not weaken the component explanation; the frozen practical-equivalence gate is additionally required.

If topology, historical rendering, and legacy-inline rendering main effects are all practically small for an A3 endpoint, component interaction or another omitted component becomes more plausible by elimination but is not established.
Cross-experiment A3, A4a, A4b, and A4c effect magnitudes are not algebraically decomposable because cohorts and manipulations differ.
Q_N remains conditional on revision and cannot be inferred when revision events are insufficient.
T_instability retains its exact two-replicate definition and has no inherent positive or negative normative valence.
Gamma_LE is a secondary factorial interaction, not a latent trait or new construct.
G_verified_minus_neutral is transition-specific and never a representation indicator.
A4c does not decompose inline rendering into labels, prose framing, separators, or state-variable syntax. Such ablation is downstream only if A4c earns causal authority.
No A4c result automatically updates B, C, H1, I1, S, or CARS; any such revision requires a separate earned update step.
